name: Elephanta Caves
description: Just a short ferry ride from Mumbai, Elephanta Island hides rock-cut temples carved into solid basalt, mostly honouring the god Shiva. The main cave is the highlight, with huge high-relief panels, including a 5.45-metre three-faced Shiva. Most of the carvings date from roughly the 5th to 7th centuries, and though many were damaged after the Portuguese arrived, they remain striking.
